hero.title: Arabic to English translator
hero.description: Arabic writing gives you no vowels and every region speaks its own way. Record the sentence or paste the text and read the English, then answer in English and let it go back in Arabic.

faq.heading: Frequently asked
faq.sub: Common questions about translating Arabic into English.

items.q: Do I need an Arabic keyboard?
items.a: No. Speak the sentence into the mic or paste the Arabic text you were sent; nothing has to be typed by you.
Everyday spoken Arabic is translated in context rather than being matched to Modern Standard Arabic word by word, which is where most tools go wrong.

items.q: Is the Arabic script displayed correctly?
items.a: Yes, right-to-left text and connected letter forms are preserved both when you paste Arabic and when a reply is translated back into it.
Yes, your English is translated into Arabic in the same thread and can be read aloud for the other person.
Each one is stored as a topic you can reopen; delete a single thread or clear the whole history whenever you like.
Yes, there is a free allowance without an account, and signing in with Google raises the monthly quota and keeps your history.
